messages:
maya: Heads-up — I spot-checked the daily aggregates and agg_user_daily counts for 2025-11-08 through 2025-11-15 are ~35-45% lower than expected. This looks correlated with the chunked-ingest change deployed last week.
alex: ugh. any error spikes in the pipeline logs?
maya: quick grep shows repeated worker OOMs in the shuffle phase on 11/10 and 11/12. sample log: `ERROR shuffle-worker-7 OOM while merging partitions`
jonah: do we have a diff between pre/post chunking for partition counts? could be a partitioning bug causing dropped partitions.
maya: I ran a diff on s3 paths — some parquet shards are missing for those days. confirmed missing file list: `s3://telemetry/parquet/day=2025-11-10/part-00{7,8}.parquet`
ingest-bot: deploy: chunked-ingest v2.4 promoted to prod at 2025-11-09T02:17Z (CI run id: 4829)
priya: ok this is definitely a backfill candidate. we need a plan that keeps dashboards useful and avoids blowing the query cluster. we also need to be careful with SLOs for online API.
alex: proposed approach: targeted recompute for exactly the missing days using recompute service (idempotent), with concurrency cap + snapshot-based checkpoints. then re-run downstream aggregates.
maya: sounds good. draft commands I tested locally: 
```
./recompute-service --source s3://telemetry/raw --target s3://telemetry/parquet-backfill \ 
  --start 2025-11-08 --end 2025-11-15 --concurrency 6 --dedupe --checkpoint-prefix s3://telemetry/backfills/1993001111/
```
jonah: add `--verify-checksum` and `--write-temp=/tmp/recompute-1993001111` so we can compare outputs before promoting. also we should generate a small sample and run it first (one day).
priya: SRE: we should schedule this during low-traffic window and have a circuit-breaker if spark executor failures exceed 5% for 10m. @sre-oncall can you reserve a maintenance window tonight 02:00-05:00 UTC?
sre-oncall: confirmed, reserving 02:00-05:30 UTC. will watch autoscaling and throttles.
alex: cost estimate: small Spark cluster (12 executors) for ~8 hours => ~150 CPU hours, plus downstream recompute ~50 CPU hours. budget ~0.6k. if we parallelize more, cost and risk go up.
maya: monitoring: I'll create a temporary dashboard (dash id: agg_backfill_1993001111) with:
- per-day row counts (before/after)
- parquet file counts in s3 prefix
- spark job failure rate
- latency on queries that depend on these aggregates
priya: also add an alert: if after-promotion diff > 2% for any day, auto-open a ticket and rollback promotion.
jonah: operational notes: ensure recompute writes to a backfill prefix and we only swap pointers after verification. no in-place overwrites.
alex: agree — pointer swap pattern: write to /parquet-backfill/<window>/v1 then update table metadata in one txn. rollback path documented.
maya: running a dry-run for 2025-11-10 now with `--concurrency 2`. I'll post sample checksums when done.
ingest-bot: backfill-job 1993001111-dryrun started at 1993001300
maya: dry-run done — checksums match expected for sample files, no OOMs. posting small diff: `rows_before=0 rows_after=1,234,567` for the sample partition.
priya: ok let's proceed with phased rollout: 1) run sequential per-day full recompute w/ concurrency=4, 2) verify checksums + dashboard, 3) swap pointers, 4) re-run downstream agg recalc. keep SRE on-call monitoring.
alex: I'll add a canary flag to the recompute job to pause after each day for manual verify: `--pause-after-day`
jonah: also add idempotency token header in job metadata so replays are safe: `X-Backfill-Token: bf-1993001111`
maya: action items: maya -> run phased recompute starting 02:00 UTC, alex -> add pause/circuit-breaker flags to recompute-service, priya -> create dashboard + alert, jonah -> verification script and checksum tool.
priya: thanks all. please update this thread with final time and any unexpected failures. :thumbsup:
